_comment: AWS Lambda Asynchronous Event Invoke Configuration (aws lambda put-function-event-invoke-config). Controls Path B (Function Execution): retries and failure destination when production_lambda_handler raises an unhandled exception. Service limits: MaximumRetryAttempts (0-2), MaximumEventAgeInSeconds (60-21600). Replace placeholders (<REGION>, <ACCOUNT_ID>, <FUNCTION_NAME>, <LAMBDA_DLQ_NAME>) before deployment.
